requirement: Find the nearest regular file with a given name by walking from a start path up through its parents, stopping at a repository root marked by .git, and provide a pytest fixture that builds file and directory trees under tmp_path for testing it.
skeleton: find_config validating the name, resolving start to a directory and looping over it and its parents checking for the file before the .git boundary, and a make_tree fixture returning a builder closure over tmp_path.
caption: Upward configuration discovery with pathlib, tested against throwaway trees built by a pytest fixture on top of tmp_path. find_config(start, name="app.toml") raises ValueError saying name must be a plain file name when the name is empty or contains a slash. It resolves start, moves to the parent when start is a file, and walks the start directory followed by each of its parents. In each directory it first returns the entry called name if it is a regular file, so a directory with that name is ignored, and only then checks whether the directory contains .git; if it does, that directory is the repository root and the search returns None instead of escaping into outer directories. If no directory matches it returns None. make_tree is a pytest.fixture taking tmp_path and returning a build function: each key ending in a slash becomes a directory created with mkdir using parents and exist_ok, every other key becomes a UTF-8 text file after creating its parent directories, and build returns tmp_path. The fixture asserts that the nearest app.toml wins from both a nested directory and the start directory itself, that a file start works, that a directory named app.toml is skipped, that the search stops at a repo containing .git even when an outer app.toml exists, that a config beside .git is still found, that a custom pyproject.toml name works, and that empty and slashed names raise ValueError.

plan.intent: Locate project configuration the way developer tools do
constraints: Empty or slashed names raise ValueError
The start directory itself is searched first
Only regular files match, never directories
A directory containing .git ends the search after checking itself
Test trees are built under tmp_path by a fixture

rationale.teaches: Iterating a path and its parents with an explicit boundary check, and a factory fixture over tmp_path for filesystem tests.
rationale.why: Skipping the start directory, matching directories or ignoring the repository boundary all pick up the wrong file, and only real trees in a temporary directory expose it.

ops.docstring: Find the nearest config file upwards, with a tmp_path tree-building fixture.

candidates.why_wrong: exists also matches a directory with the config name, so it is returned as the config.
The boundary is checked before the file, so a config beside .git is never found.
Without the .git boundary the search escapes the repository and finds an outer config.
The start directory is skipped, so a config right there is passed over for a parent's.
Empty or nested names are accepted and silently search for the wrong path.
